title: Why Do We Have Gravity?
narration: This 3D Short is only about this: Why Do We Have Gravity.
Earth is huge, so it pulls you down.
Let me show you that in 3D.
Jump, and gravity calls you back.
Watch this next bit closely. This is why it happens.
The moon has gravity too, just weaker.
So the idea is simple: cause, then effect.
The pictures today are a new apple world. Not yesterday's film.
That is the whole idea, in one short 3D film.
Stay to the end. The last shot is the takeaway for why do we have gravity.
If a grown-up is with you, pause and tell them the cause in one sentence.
Tomorrow a brand new 3D film. Same curious science. Brand new pictures.
